text:
tomas: quick sync — need a decision on the "provenance shim" we discussed in RFC. problem: where to canonicalize tenant identity so cost attribution + sampling are stable across region/ingest migrations. proposal: lightweight edge sidecar shims that emit a minimal provenance header (hashed tenant id + request id). @meenal @carter PTAL — this touches privacy, latency, and ingest lookup logic.

meenal: :eyes: can you sketch threat model? hashing helps but we need rotation and psuedonymization guarantees. any PII risk if we ever expand header payload? also how will lookup work if we need original tenant for billing?

carter: latency-wise sidecar is fine if it's O(100us). avoid heavy crypto per-request. i'd suggest siphash64 keyed with a per-region secret (KMS rotation) or truncated sha256 if we need auditability. ingest can cache mapping of hash->tenant for a short window. fallback when lookup misses = mark as "anon" and surface metric.

lina: rollout concerns: we should do canary 10% region, then 50%, then full. add observability: histogram of missing-provenance, mapping-miss-rate, dwell-time-in-cache. also add a migration job to backfill traces that had signature present before cutover.

obs-bot: RFC link: https://redwoodinference.internal/rfcs/2026/provenance-shim (branch: prov-shim-v2). CI: perf-tests/provenance-shim triggered.

tomas: sketch of header we'd emit:```
X-RW-PROV: sha256:<hex>   // tenant hash (stable for rotation window)
X-RW-REQ-ID: <uuid>      // request-level id for stitchability
```keep header minimal (<=64 bytes). do not include email/tenant name.

meenal: rotation plan: per-region secret stored in KMS; rotation window = 30d default. need a migration table that records previous hashes for 90d to avoid attribution gaps. legal ok? pinging privacy for sign-off. :thinking:

carter: perf tests: i'll run microbench with 1000rps and 10k concurrent connections on canary sidecar. will measure P50/P99 overhead and extra bytes on wire. also will add synthetic ingestion misses to see downstream alerting. assigning to myself.

lina: testing + metrics: add metric `ingest.prov.lookup.miss` and `ingest.prov.cache.latency`; dashboard + alert if miss_rate > 0.5% for 15m. also add query to detect spread of `anon` attribution by tenant id ranges.

tomas: decision: go with edge shim that emits hashed tenant + req id. hashing in sidecar with siphash64 keyed to KMS per-region. ingest keeps an LRU mapping cache and falls back to "anon" on miss. rollout: canary 10% -> 50% -> 100% with observability gates. follow-ups: i'll update RFC with design + rollout playbook. carter -> perf harness, meenal -> privacy doc + rotation plan, lina -> dashboards + alert. thanks! :thumbsup:

carter: noted. will post perf results into the thread once done.

meenal: will coordinate privacy review and post notes.

lina: will create dashboards and alert runbook.

obs-bot: created task RW-8432: "provenance shim rollout" assigned to tomas, carter, meenal, lina.
